page.title: Channels
page.description: Housetel sends every channel your availability, rates and restrictions, and brings their bookings into the PMS without anyone typing them.
page.emptyTitle: You are not selling on any channel yet
page.emptyHint: Connect BookSim or AirSim to try it without credentials, Airbnb or VRBO through iCal, or Booking.com and Expedia through Channex.
page.addAnotherHint: One inventory, no overbooking: every booking lowers the availability everywhere.

booksim.name: BookSim
booksim.description: A test OTA inside Housetel: it receives your availability and rates at once and sends you bookings from the simulator.

airsim.name: AirSim
airsim.description: Another test OTA. Use it next to BookSim to see a booking on one channel lower the availability on the other.

ical.name: Airbnb, VRBO or Booking (iCal)
ical.description: Publish a calendar per room type so the site blocks the nights you sold, and import theirs to bring their bookings in. No rates.

channex.name: Booking.com and Expedia (Channex)
channex.description: 50+ OTAs through Channex: availability, rates and restrictions out, bookings back in. Sandbox, production or simulated.

card.deleteDescription: Housetel will stop sending it availability and rates and receiving its bookings. The bookings that already arrived stay in the PMS.
card.synced: {{channel}}: 365 days of availability and rates sent
card.syncFailed: {{channel}} could not be synced: check the log
card.pausedToast: {{channel}} paused: it gets no changes and sends no bookings
card.pulledWithErrors_one: {{count}} booking could not be processed: check the log
card.pulledWithErrors_other: {{count}} bookings could not be processed: check the log
card.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the URL and copy it by hand

wizard.title: Connect a channel

channel.label: Channel
channel.hint: Choose where you want to sell. You can connect several: there is a single inventory.

setup.label: Connection
setup.hint: Name it and choose how it connects.

mapping.label: Mapping
mapping.hint: Which room types and rates the channel sees, with which code and at what price.

review.label: Confirm
review.hint: Check what the channel is about to receive before connecting it.

wizard.name: Name

nameHint.booksim: It shows up like this in Channels, the log and the bookings.
nameHint.airsim: It shows up like this in Channels, the log and the bookings.
nameHint.ical: The site the calendars come from, such as “Airbnb” or “VRBO”.
nameHint.channex: It shows up like this in Channels, the log and the bookings.

ical.simulated: No internet: only reads calendars exported by Housetel. Good for trying it out.
ical.real: Downloads the Airbnb, VRBO or Booking.com calendars over HTTPS every 15 minutes.

channex.simulated: No internet: the ARI lands in the simulator and its bookings are pulled like the Channex feed.
channex.real: Talks to the Channex API (sandbox or production) with your API key.

wizard.modeShared: The mode is saved for the whole hotel and can also be changed in Settings → Integrations.
wizard.secretStored: One is already saved. Leave it empty to keep it.
wizard.importAllHint: Turn it on for Booking.com, which marks every booking as “CLOSED - Not available”. Airbnb and VRBO do not need it.
wizard.simulatedNote: This OTA lives inside Housetel: use it to try the whole cycle without credentials. Its bookings are made from the OTA simulator.
wizard.roomsHint: Every checked room type is published on the channel with its code. Unchecked ones are not sold there.
wizard.calendarsHint: Every checked room type gets its export URL. Paste the site's iCal URL to import its bookings (optional).
wizard.ratesHint: The channel gets the plan price plus the markup. Plans that are not public or not open to the channel reach it closed.
wizard.noRates: There are no active rate plans for the checked room types.
wizard.planInactive: The plan is inactive: the channel will get it closed.
wizard.planNotPublic: The plan is not public: the channel will get it closed.
wizard.planNotOnChannel: The plan is not open to {{channel}}: it will reach it closed.
wizard.catalogHint: Bring the Channex rooms and rates in to pick the codes instead of copying them.
wizard.catalogLoaded: {{rooms}} rooms and {{rates}} rates available in the code fields.
wizard.fullSync: Send 365 days of availability and rates now
wizard.fullSyncHint: Recommended: the channel is up to date from the first minute. Unchecked, the data travels with the queue in a few seconds.

review.noRates: No rates: the channel only gets availability
review.icalNote_zero: Housetel will publish one calendar per room type. Copy their URLs from the connection card and paste them on the site.
review.icalNote_one: Housetel will publish one calendar per room type and import {{count}} calendar from the site every 15 minutes.
review.icalNote_other: Housetel will publish one calendar per room type and import {{count}} calendars from the site every 15 minutes.

problems.name: Give the connection a name.
problems.noRooms: Check at least one room type.
problems.roomCode: Every checked room type needs its channel code.
problems.rateCode: Every checked rate needs its channel code.
problems.markup: The markup must be a number from −90 to 300.
problems.url: Check the calendar URLs: they must start with https:// or webcal://.

wizard.connectedSynced: {{channel}} connected: it already got 365 days of availability and rates
wizard.savedSyncFailed: {{channel}} was saved, but sending failed: check the outgoing queue

log.emptyHint: Every availability update and every booking that comes from a channel is recorded here.

queue.upToDate: The channels are up to date
queue.sentWithErrors: {{sent}} sent and {{failed}} failing: check the log
queue.emptyHint: When a rate, a booking or a block changes, the update waits here a few seconds before it travels to the channel.

sim.title: OTA simulator
sim.description: Take the OTA's side: see what Housetel sent it and make bookings that reach the PMS the same way a real channel's do.
sim.emptyHint: Connect BookSim, AirSim or a simulated Channex from Channels and come back.
sim.deliveryPush: Delivered to the PMS at once
sim.noAri: No ARI received yet: run a full sync from Channels
sim.paused: The connection is paused: the OTA gets no changes and no bookings can be made until it resumes.
sim.noRooms: The OTA has no mapped rooms
sim.noRoomsHint: Edit the connection mapping in Channels to publish room types.

legend.title: Legend
legend.click: Tap a night for sale to book it in the OTA.

sim.forbiddenTitle: Only channel managers use the simulator
sim.forbiddenHint: The simulator creates real bookings in the PMS. Ask your hotel admin for the “Manage channels” permission.
sim.unavailableTitle: The OTA simulator does not exist in this environment
sim.unavailableHint: BookSim and AirSim are demo tools: simulations are turned off here. Connect your real channels (iCal or Channex) from Channels.

ota.gridCaption: Availability, rates and restrictions {{ota}} received from Housetel

otaBooking.createHint: Act as a guest booking on {{ota}}. The booking reaches the PMS like a real channel's.
otaBooking.modifyHint: The guest changes the booking on the OTA: the PMS gets a new revision. Nights they already had keep their price.
otaBooking.guestHint: Leave it empty and the OTA makes up a Colombian or foreign guest.
otaBooking.checking: Checking what the OTA has for sale…
otaBooking.notSellable: The OTA cannot sell it like this
otaBooking.forceHint: You can force it to simulate an overbooking: the PMS receives it anyway and raises the overbooking alert.
otaBooking.created: {{id}} booked on the OTA → {{code}} in the PMS
otaBooking.modified: Change to {{id}} applied in the PMS ({{code}})
otaBooking.waitingPull: {{id}} created on Channex: the PMS downloads it on its next read
otaBooking.importFailed: {{id}} reached the PMS but could not be processed: {{message}}

otaBookings.pushHint: {{ota}} delivers every booking, change or cancellation to the PMS right away.
otaBookings.pullHint: Channex keeps the bookings until the PMS downloads them (every 5 minutes or with the button).
otaBookings.emptyHint: Create one and watch it appear in the PMS bookings, with the channel and the OTA code.
otaBookings.cancelDescription: The OTA sends the cancellation to the PMS, which frees the room without a penalty (the OTA applies its own policy).
otaBookings.cancelPullDescription: Channex keeps the cancellation until the PMS downloads the feed.
otaBookings.cancelled: {{id}} cancelled: the PMS already freed the room
otaBookings.cancelledPending: {{id}} cancelled on Channex: the PMS applies it on download
otaBookings.cancelFailed: {{id}} was cancelled on the OTA but the PMS could not apply it: {{message}}
otaBookings.deliverFailed: The PMS could not process it: {{message}}
